goal: A school nurse, a woman of about thirty with short black hair, a white nurse's uniform, a small white nurse's cap, and white shoes, smiles and holds a small first-aid bag with no symbol on it. One clear picture, the main thing large in the middle, a plain light background.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element picture. Picture 1 is a character sheet of the school nurse in four views (front, three-quarter, side, back). Use only the front view and copy her exactly: a woman of about thirty with short black hair, a small white nurse cap, a white short-sleeved tunic, white trousers, white shoes, a gentle smile, and a small plain white first-aid bag with a handle, with no symbol and no cross on it. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The picture: one clear picture, a full-body shot from the front. The nurse stands in the middle of the picture, large, about 85 percent of the frame height, and smiles at the viewer. She holds the small plain white first-aid bag in her right hand (on the left side of the picture); her other arm hangs relaxed with a natural hand. The background is plain, light, and empty (a very pale cream wall and a soft floor shadow). Draw her once only. The bag is plain white with no symbol, no cross, and no writing. Her face has clean eye corners with no marks. The page text is "A nurse." and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Keep the nurse, her cap, her hair, her first-aid bag with its handle, and her shoes as thick, closed outlines. Draw only one soft ground line. The bag stays plain with no symbol. Draw each head of hair as one closed shape. Simplify the background: draw only a few large, simple, closed shapes. No small details, no grass blades, no small leaves, no hatching, no tick marks, no wood grain lines. Every shape is closed with one thick line. Draw no cloud and no hill. Draw only one soft ground line. Every shape is closed or runs to the edge of the picture. Both hands are closed shapes. The outline of each object (a branch, a leaf cluster, a bag, a table, a tree) is one closed shape that does not run into a hill line or a floor line. Use few background shapes and no bushes or hills that are not needed.
